findings.text: The company status is 'liquidation' and there is one insolvency case on record for a creditors voluntary liquidation wound up on 20 March 2026.
Accounts are overdue with the next due date being 30 November 2025, while the last accounts were made up to 29 February 2024.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company.
One person with significant control, PERSON 301, holds between 75 and 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
Since 24 October 2025, there was one officer appointment and one resignation, involving PERSON 292 being appointed and PERSON 293 resigning as director on 7 November 2025.
The current director, PERSON 292, has two other appointments which are both dissolved.
One registered office address change was filed on 1 April 2026.

headline.text: ACME LTD (91000424) is in liquidation following a creditors voluntary liquidation wound up on 20 March 2026, with overdue accounts and two outstanding charges.
